Why do wealthy buyers pay cash for their homes?

Kevin Trudeau says they see a mortgage as the worst kind of loan. So they buy the home outright, then use the home itself as collateral for a line of credit.

That gives them access to cash when they need it, and if they don't use it, they pay no interest. Kevin presents it as a different way of thinking about credit.

Had you ever heard of buying a home this way?
